items.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

items.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
items.summary: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

items.title: StoneX lifts Strive price target 34% as new stock offering bolsters bitcoin strategy
items.summary: StoneX has raised its price target for bitcoin treasury company Strive to $43 from $32 and reiterated its Buy rating on the stock.

items.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Trust Bank Approval for RLUSD Reserves and Custody
items.summary: RLUSD will retain its New York-regulated issuer while the national trust bank manages reserves and provides fiduciary digital asset custody.
